title: Heavy Metal Index — food & ingredient occurrence data
description: Measured heavy-metal occurrence distributions per ingredient and analyte (typical range, 95th percentile, study count, confidence, contributing sources), compiled from the peer-reviewed and regulatory literature. Values are in ppb (µg/kg) on the basis each source reported.
